newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sees Jan-June trade gap down yr-yr 37.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sees Jan-June trade gap down yr-yr 37.8 pct.

text.p: Vietnam's official news agency said on Tuesday that the country's trade deficit for the first half of this year was estimated at $1.433 billion, a 37.8-percent decrease from the same period of 1996.
Vietnam News Agency said in a brief despatch that the decline in the deficit could be attributed to government measures such as controlling inflation, promoting exports and limiting imports.
